Type.Description: Model of net.get_sys and result.get_ss(): 'ODE' (the bus voltages eliminated) or 'DAE' (the connected model with the bus voltages as algebraic variables)

Coordinate.Description: Bus variables of the 'DAE' model: 'theta&rho' (angle and log magnitude), 'theta&V' (angle and magnitude) or 'Vre&Vim' (real and imaginary parts)

PlotFcn.Description: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.plot_eigenvalue()
